stem: After increasing canopy light intensity, which follow-up check is most defensible before increasing light further?
choices: Review plant response together with temperature, water availability, and root-zone conditions
Ignore irrigation because light operates independently
Judge success only by fixture wattage
Assume higher PPFD always improves growth
rationale: Increasing photon exposure can change crop demand and interacts with temperature, transpiration, irrigation, and root-zone conditions. Lighting decisions should be evaluated as part of the whole production environment.
